name: oh-my-joy
description: AI says it's done. OMJ makes it prove it. One workflow for Claude Code and Codex: small tasks run through a checked playbook, risky or large ones get one critiqued plan to approve, and every run ends in a plain report with recorded evidence and resume. Figma-to-code built in.

interface.shortDescription: No proof, no done: critiqued plans and evidence-backed execution.
interface.longDescription: Run small tasks through checked playbooks; interview a fuzzy idea or plan risky and large work with an independent critique and one approval; execute with review, verification evidence (command and exit code), plain five-part reports, and resume. Includes Figma-to-code with real browser checks.
defaultPrompt: Turn this concrete coding task into an implementation plan with $oh-my-joy:ralplan.
Clarify this fuzzy product idea with $oh-my-joy:deep-interview.
Run this small, bounded change and verify it with $oh-my-joy:ultragoal.
